# apple_ci_mac_os_versions (Data Source)

Lists the macOS versions Xcode Cloud offers, with the Xcode versions each runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_mac_os_versions" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `mac_os_versions` (Attributes List) The macOS versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mac_os_versions))

<a id="nestedatt--mac_os_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mac_os_versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the macOS version.
- `name` (String) Name, e.g. `macOS Tahoe 26`.
- `version` (String) Version, e.g. `26.0`.
- `xcode_version_ids` (List of String) App Store Connect IDs of the Xcode versions this macOS version runs.
